GenzCalc

Every calculator. One app.

GenzCalc brings loans, SIPs, BMI, discounts and many more calculations into one offline app, with results that update as you type.

Visit the GenzCalc website (opens in a new tab)

GenzCalc is coming soon to iPhone. The store link will be added here at launch.

What GenzCalc does

  • Ten categories

    Finance, health, business, education, travel, home, vehicles, construction, units and everyday maths.

  • Instant results

    Answers update as you type, with a clear breakdown of inputs and outputs.

  • Formulas explained

    See how results such as EMI are worked out.

  • Favourites and history

    Pin calculators to Quick Access and revisit saved calculations.

  • Share results

    Copy or share a result or the full breakdown.
